definitions.gloss: practical work, actual business, hands-on work
definitions.explanation: The day-to-day practical tasks and operations of a job or organization, as opposed to planning, management, or theory.

examples.japanese: {実務|じつむ}{経験|けいけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
{実務|じつむ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{若手|わかて}→若手：13989_wakate⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧だ。
examples.english: The junior employees are in charge of the practical work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{理論|りろん}→理論：04708_riron⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧{実務|じつむ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{人材|じんざい}→人材：11426_jinzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てたい→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧。
examples.english: We want to develop people who are strong not just in theory but also in practical work.

notes:
{実務|じつむ} combines ⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧ (actual, real) and {務|む} (duty, work).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実務|じつむ}{経験|けいけん} (practical work experience)
- {実務|じつむ}{者|しゃ} (practitioner, person in charge of operations)
- {実務|じつむ}⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧ (practical ability)
- {実務|じつむ}⟦レベル→レベル：00352_reberu⟧ (operational level)
- {実務|じつむ}⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧ (person handling the actual work)

USAGE:
Commonly used in business and professional contexts. Often contrasted with ⟦{理論|りろん}→理論：04708_riron⟧ (theory) or ⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧ (management) to emphasize hands-on, operational work.
